exec("import json,pathlib,hashlib,time
import hanlp
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in pathlib.Path('context/evaluation/company_shared_local_semantics_slice_a.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if x.strip()]

ok=[]; fail=[]; counts={'runtime':0,'index':0,'value':0,'other':0}
for i,row in enumerate(rows):
 text=str(row.get('raw_message') or '')
 try:
  model([list(text)])
  ok.append((i,len(text)))
 except Exception as e:
  fail.append((i,len(text),hashlib.sha256(str(row.get('stable_key') or '').encode()).hexdigest()))
  n=type(e).__name__
  if n=='RuntimeError': counts['runtime']+=1

  elif n=='ValueError': counts['value']+=1
  else: counts['other']+=1
